authorized_scope: Prepare HydroLAKES, Free-Flowing Rivers and LakeATLAS releases locally; consider JRC Occurrence v1.5 by qualifying original tiles first. Review current versions and further HydroSHEDS opportunities. No uploads, remote repo creation, registry submission, GEE or paid cloud jobs.
acceptance_before_results: Pin the current exact producer release, archive identities, metadata and attribution before conversion; distinguish latest release from observation vintage.

Preserve all released records, IDs, decoded attribute types/values/nulls and WKB geometry, with a complete independent source reread comparison; no repair, simplification or deduplication in analytic output.
GeoParquet CRS/geometry metadata must validate; deliberate row/value/geometry/null corruption must be rejected. Bound conversion memory and staging disk.
Use an isolated output directory, committed code and locked environment; repeat the build from a clean checkout and compare analytic asset hashes.
Keep display output optional and independently labeled; an analytic-only release is allowed. Do not consume disk making unnecessary copies of existing validated data.
Produce checksum-bound source manifest, field dictionary, license/attribution, limitations and STAC/Portolan metadata; run actual schema checks and local HTTP-range/subset verification.
Mark prepared only after the applicable source-fidelity, schema, integrity and rebuild checks pass. Retain failed reports and label deferred checks.

For JRC, inventory the complete exact-version Occurrence scope and inspect representative source tile layout/range access. A sampled check cannot certify all 504 objects; convert only if a documented need remains.

resource_limits.disk: Approximately 40 GiB free at start. Reuse retained artifacts, use streaming/chunked processing; no unbounded copies or large parallel source extraction. Check free space before bulk writes.
resource_limits.jrc: Start with metadata and bounded header/range probes, not a full 14.45 GB mirror.

ownership.parent: shared schema/catalog/scripts, HydroLAKES build integration and release execution
ownership.lakeatlas: datasets/lakeatlas only; scripts/metadata and own ignored local directories
ownership.ffr: datasets/free-flowing-rivers only; scripts/metadata and own ignored local directories
